messages.content: You help flood rescue teams read residents' clips.

content.text: A resident filmed this clip in a flooded street. Estimate the water depth range in metres where people and vehicles are, and say whether the water flows. Describe in one sentence what happens, in English (what_happens_en) and in Vietnamese (what_happens_local). Transcribe anything said on the audio in its own language (speech) and translate it to English (speech_en); both empty if nothing is said.

response.content: {"depth_m": {"high": 0.5, "low": 0.3}, "speech": "", "speech_en": "", "water_flow": "slow", "what_happens_en": "Several people wade and push stalled motorbikes through knee-deep brown floodwater while SUVs, vans and other motorbikes slowly move through the flooded street in front of a gated monument.", "what_happens_local": "Ng\u01b0\u1eddi d\u00e2n l\u1ed9i n\u01b0\u1edbc v\u00e0 d\u1eaft xe m\u00e1y ch\u1ebft m\u00e1y qua \u0111o\u1ea1n \u0111\u01b0\u1eddng ng\u1eadp \u0111\u1ebfn \u0111\u1ea7u g\u1ed1i trong khi \u00f4 t\u00f4, xe t\u1ea3i nh\u1ecf v\u00e0 xe m\u00e1y kh\u00e1c ch\u1eadm r\u00e3i di chuy\u1ec3n qua khu v\u1ef1c ng\u1eadp tr\u01b0\u1edbc c\u1ed5ng t\u01b0\u1ee3ng \u0111\u00e0i."}
